synthesis.decision: Gearbox v1 VERIFIED_PASS and Step001-009 verified baseline are preserved. Any v2/v2.1 FAIL/DEFER rolls back only the candidate delta.
A stale secretary signal must not influence gear, and a secretary signal conflicting with fresher formal authority must be invalidated. Formal authority always wins.

Current v2.1 accepts caller booleans secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict. That is not a trusted freshness/authority proof. Require a replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope bound to signal hash/source/issued_at/observed_at/TTL policy and exact fresh authority snapshot, with freshness/conflict derived inside a trusted boundary. W07 latest is newer than its still-initialization receipt, so W07 must not be treated as fresh GREEN.

Anti-thrash may suppress only nonessential upshift. Current v2.1 structurally gates anti-thrash on selected_gear > current_gear, so risk/recovery downshift is not delayed by the overlay; verified v1 lower-guard-first behavior remains the safety baseline.

recent_shift_rate_ratio=0.50 is heuristic. Require versioned observation window, denominator/minimum support, release hysteresis/cooldown, clean baseline plus incident replay, false-positive/missed-warning accounting, and bounded upshift/recovery latency with throughput non-regression.

event_id-only dedupe permits the same durable evidence to be replayed under new IDs and credited repeatedly. Require canonical evidence/event lineage identity including evidence_hash, provenance/source lineage and trusted verifier receipt identity; event_id may be an index only.

bool(independently_verified) is unsafe: non-empty strings such as 'false' evaluate true. Verified Experience requires strict typed verification plus exact payload/evidence hash, trusted verifier receipt/identity/policy, mission/step binding and acceptance/revocation state.

Heartbeat, window age, poll, retry, reconnect, wait and scheduler wake are zero Experience. DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are operational-only. P_base, Identity, Personality, Governance and formal authority remain unchanged.

No speedup is established. Only paired matched-workload evidence may support a claim: durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency, with equal-or-better verification/risk. Window age, commit count and task last_run are forbidden speed evidence.

Predictive Navigator probability bands and pressure/gear thresholds are engineering heuristics, not calibrated probabilities. Require clean baseline plus incident replay and TP/FP/TN/FN or false-positive/missed-warning statistics before threshold adoption.

Predictive Navigator v2 uses bool(value) for boolean precursors. Non-empty strings such as 'false' therefore become True and can create false RED/HIGH precursors. Missing continuity flags also default to False, which can manufacture recovery-anchor failure rather than representing UNKNOWN. Require strict typed tri-state input validation (TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN), provenance/freshness metadata and fail-closed UNKNOWN handling before predictive output may influence Gearbox adoption.

One exact-current runner must execute v1 tests + v2 tests + v2.1 tests together. Current exact source/test blobs are identified (v1 21 tests, v2 16, v2.1 12), but no single combined exact-current execution evidence was produced in this Navigator run; existing v2 selftest is explicitly not sufficient.
No fresh dedicated W03/Spirit Gearbox v2.1 adversarial review is present. Existing SPIRIT_LATEST is older Small-World/Privacy work and cannot be treated as concurrence.

newer fresh authority conflict invalidates secretary even if caller claims no conflict
secretary envelope TTL/replay/clock rollback cannot regain freshness

independently_verified values 'false', '0', objects and lists fail closed

Predictive Navigator strict boolean/tri-state test: string 'false' is rejected, not coerced true
Predictive Navigator missing precursor fields remain UNKNOWN and do not silently become negative/positive evidence
clean baseline plus W01 incident replay records false positives and missed warnings
paired matched baseline/candidate speed benchmark excludes window age, commits and task last_run
